name: NinjaOne
summary: NinjaOne does not publish a full price list. Its pricing page says rates start as low as $1.50 per device per month at 10,000 endpoints and rise to $3.75 at 50 or fewer, varying by region and products. It offers a 14-day trial, no implementation fee, and cancellation on 60 days' notice for partners without a promotional commitment.

facts.text: The page cites patching of Windows, macOS and Linux operating systems plus over 200 third-party applications.
NinjaOne lists FedRAMP Class C certification, SOC 2 Type II attestation, ISO/IEC 27001 certification and GDPR compliance, with a HIPAA BAA available.
The quoted rates apply to the commercial, non-FedRAMP instance only.
Support is described as free and unlimited, and implementation is not charged.

plans.name: Per-device pricing
plans.notes: Published range is $1.50 per device per month at 10,000 endpoints to $3.75 at 50 or fewer endpoints. Full pricing is by request

hiddenCosts: The page says full pricing is not listed publicly and that rates vary by region and products purchased.
Month-to-month billing is decided case by case.

contract.cancellation: Partners without a promotional commitment can cancel at any time with 60 days' notice.
